notes: All 82 team keys are season-scoped canonical participant identifiers from the existing roster inventory.
These are club-owned official website/news ENTRY URLs, not proof of live access or of any player injury, starting five, official medical status, fixture or availability timestamp.
NBA official site paths are anchored in NBA.com team directory; URLs not separately seen in web results require live path verification.
Some entries route to club homepages because a separately verified news index path could not be established; do not pretend they are dedicated news feeds.
Keep the original six-probe injury parser sealed. Any 82-club HTTP batch run is opt-in, robots-gated, no redirects, bounded size/time and metadata-only.
Special identity guards: Paris Basketball uses parisbasketball.com (NOT parisbasketball.paris); two Roma clubs have distinct hosts; 2026/27 Besiktas in EuroLeague and Bosna in EuroCup.
